Problem Description
: Outlet 4 is not working
Troubleshooting
: We have analyzed the logs and identified an issue with the IMD_BC4 related to Modbus communication, where the standby insulation monitor state is not valid. To resolve this, we need to check the IMD connections and other related connections. Please ensure to carry extra spares in case the component itself is faulty.
MLFB :  8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1.
Below are some troubleshooting steps:
Please check +F04-XD41, +F04-XD10.2A , +F03-XD10.2B terminals related to earth and KF4 module connections respectively.
Please check +24VDC supply to IMD and its ISO_relay.
Check the profibus connections as well.
